answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 15 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 900 identities costs 900 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The inlet test is the live device, the sparrow test is the locked stake, and the onyx test is the graded history no template can fake.
